overview: Neodragon proposes a mobile-optimized video Diffusion Transformer system that applies four key optimizations—Text-Encoder Distillation, Asymmetric Decoder Distillation, MMDiT Block Pruning, and Pyramidal DMD Step Distillation—to enable high-fidelity text-to-video generation on low-power NPUs while preserving generation quality.

modules.name: Pyramidal Flow Matching Core
modules.description: Implements the foundational Pyramidal Flow Matching training and inference framework, including the multi-stage probability flow decomposition with overlapping noise schedules, the stagewise Flow-Matching loss aggregation, and the Euler-based ODE solver for generation across spatial-temporal pyramid stages with causal autoregressive conditioning.

modules.name: MMDiT Denoiser Architecture
modules.description: Implements the Multi-Modal Diffusion Transformer backbone processing concatenated visual latent tokens, textual tokens from the distilled encoder, and CLIP embedding tokens, including the block-level forward pass with dual attention pathways for visual and textual streams, RoPE positional encoding with 6D tensor operations, causal attention masking, and classifier-free guidance integration.

modules.name: Text Encoder Distillation Framework
modules.description: Implements the prompt-only distillation pipeline that compresses the large T5XXL text encoder into a lightweight DT5 model via a trainable ContextAdapter (CA) module, supporting multiple operational modes (Replace, Extend, LoRA, Trainable-DT5), with the combined MSE and Cosine Distance loss between CA-predicted and ground-truth ContextEmbedder tokens for stable alignment without image or video data.

modules.name: Asymmetric Decoder Distillation
modules.description: Implements the cross-model decoder replacement framework that substitutes the native codec-latent-VAE decoder with a mobile-friendly asymmetric decoder from a different pretrained VDM, including architectural modifications to match the fixed encoder's compression factor, frozen-encoder fine-tuning with combined MSE and LPIPS reconstruction losses, and support for multiple decoder candidates (TinyAEHV, Cosmos, LTXVideo, Wan).

modules.name: Block Importance Scoring
modules.description: Implements the calibration-based block importance analysis for the MMDiT denoiser, computing separate visual and textual importance scores as the Cosine Distance between each block's input and output tokens across both CFG passes (descriptive and negative prompts), using a diverse calibration prompt set with multiple video samples per prompt for robust estimation.

modules.name: Block Pruning Stage-1 Fine-tuning
modules.description: Implements the first-stage recovery fine-tuning after block removal, training the pruned MMDiT with the original Flow-Matching objective on ground-truth video data using causal conditioning on corrupted history frames, with extremely short convergence requiring only hundreds of iterations to establish a performance lower bound for the pruned architecture.

modules.name: Block Pruning Stage-2 Fine-tuning
modules.description: Implements the second-stage teacher-student distillation fine-tuning incorporating feature-matching losses between the full teacher model and pruned student model, including MSE loss on visual tokens, Cosine Distance loss on textual tokens, Flow-Matching losses using both teacher predictions and ground-truth data flow, and configurable block-mapping strategies (Simple vs. Next-Block) for aligning student and teacher blocks.

modules.name: Pyramidal DMD Step Distillation
modules.description: Implements the novel extension of Distribution Matching Distillation to the Pyramidal Flow-Matching objective, including the student model parameterized as a single-step Euler solver predicting clean latents, the Fake-Score-Model trained on student-predicted clean latent distributions with pyramidal Flow-Matching loss, the DMD gradient-based loss with sample-specific weighting, supervised Cauchy loss for visual quality, and alternating student/fake model updates with differentiated noise level sampling strategies.

modules.name: Alternative Step Distillation Methods
modules.description: Implements the three alternative step distillation baselines adapted for Pyramidal Flow-Matching: (1) Pyramidal Mean-Flows with mean velocity field conditioning and scaled instantaneous velocity correction; (2) Pyramidal Progressive Distillation with teacher trajectory simulation and student one-step matching using squared L2 loss; (3) Pyramidal Adversarial Step Distillation adding patchwise GAN loss with teacher-feature-based discriminator on top of the progressive distillation objective.

modules.name: Codec-Latent VAE with Tile-Enabled Decoding
modules.description: Implements the spatio-temporal VAE encoder and decoder architecture with causal 3D convolutions and attention mid-blocks, supporting [8×8×8] compression factor, tile-enabled decoding for memory-efficient high-resolution inference, and the asymmetric decoder variant integration with modified temporal/spatial upsampling layers to match the fixed latent space.

modules.name: First Frame Generation and Conditioning
modules.description: Implements the hybrid first-frame initialization strategy using SSD-1B text-to-image model to generate a high-quality initial frame, including CLIP embedding extraction for the first frame, VAE encoding of the first frame to the latent space, and injection of the encoded first frame as conditioning for the subsequent pyramidal autoregressive denoising to mitigate step-distillation-induced semantic artifacts in the first frame.

modules.name: Super-Resolution Post-Processing
modules.description: Implements the QuickSRNet-based 2× spatial super-resolution module applied after VAE decoding to upscale the generated video from [320×512] to [640×1024] resolution, serving as the final pipeline stage with optimized inference for on-device deployment.

modules.name: Video Data Pipeline and Augmentation
modules.description: Implements the curated video dataset loading from mixed sources (OpenSora Stock Videos, Panda-70M) with text prompts, including video preprocessing (center-crop, resize, normalization), latent encoding via the frozen VAE encoder, temporal frame sampling for pyramidal conditioning with Gaussian noise corruption of history frames during training, and custom batch sampling strategies for variable-length video sequences.

modules.name: Evaluation and Benchmarking Framework
modules.description: Implements the comprehensive evaluation pipeline including VBench metric computation (Total, Quality, Semantic, Dynamic Degree, Flicker, Aesthetics, Imaging, Object, Scene, Consistency), DAVIS PSNR for decoder reconstruction assessment, and method-blinded human preference study with randomized pairwise comparisons across multiple VBench prompt dimensions.

modules.name: NPU Deployment Compilation
modules.description: Implements the model compilation pipeline for Qualcomm Hexagon NPU deployment, including multi-resolution MMDiT graph porting with dynamic history padding and attention mask adjustment, precomputation of MMDiT constant inputs (shapes, trainable token lengths, timestep embeddings), 6D tensor reduction for RoPE computation optimization, causal mask value rescaling for fixed-point numerical stability, and T5 residual connection activation rescaling to prevent FP16 saturation.

modules.name: End-to-End Inference Orchestration
modules.description: Implements the full Neodragon E2E inference pipeline coordinating all optimized components in sequence: CLIP text embedding extraction, DistilT5 text encoding with ContextAdapter, SSD-1B first frame generation, VAE encoding of the first frame, block-pruned step-distilled MMDiT denoising across three pyramidal resolutions with 1-1-1 schedule, VAE decoding with asymmetric decoder, and QuickSRNet super-resolution, including memory management and latency profiling across Snapdragon X Elite and Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen4 platforms.
